title: Apache superset: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python (CVE-2026-111066)
description: A high-severity security vulnerability (CVE-2026-111066) affects the apache-superset package, specifically related to the AIOHTTP asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. The vulnerability impacts versions prior to 2021.38.2-r0 and 2021.36.5-r0. A fix has been released in these versions to address the issue.
